title: Procedural high-res heightmap synthesis to eliminate cell-grid hexagons
description: Replace cell-rasterized texture rendering with high-res procedurally-synthesized heightmap anchored to simulation cells. Simulation provides large-scale structure (continents, mountain belts, ocean basins); procedural noise synthesizes sub-cell terrain detail (ridges, valleys, hills, coastlines). Targets 4096x2048 R32F heightmap with 6+ octaves of domain-warped ridge/billow/fBm noise, biome-aware color synthesis, procedural river overlay from high-res gradient. Cell-grid hexagons should be invisible at any zoom.
